__Rewards__

Downloadable and printable reward checklists can be found __here__.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dde64adadf4e4ce98c65c4450276af75~mv2.jpg)

__Base Rewards__

100% Drop Rate

- 50 Caps
- 400 XP
- Event Plan
- 3x Halloween Food Items
- 1-3x Improved Bait
- 1-3x Legendary Modules
- RadAway
- Stimpaks

**Player Title: Goblin** 

**Suffix**

Stops dropping once learnt

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b43d629f8a044c459b36aa4470e36539~mv2.jpg)

__Halloween Foods__

Providing the event does not fail, you will always receive 3x Halloween Food.

- Blackberry Honey Crisp
- Bubblegum
- Cotton Candy Bites
- Corn
- Fancy Lad Snack Cakes
- Fancy Lad Snack Cakes – Pre-War Clean
- Funnel Cake
- Gumdrops
- Potato Crisps
- Tasty Pumpkin Pie
- Pumpkin
- Sugar Bombs w/Rads
- Sugar Bombs – Pre-War Clean
- Sweet Roll
- Yum Yum Deviled Eggs

__Plan Rewards__

Providing the event does not fail, you will always receive a plan.

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)

Thanks for your support!
